# Group totals

```{r}
d <- read.csv("data/sales.csv", colClasses = c("character", "numeric"), na.strings=c("", "NA"))
d <- d[is.finite(d$amount), , drop = FALSE]
d$group[is.na(d$group)] <- "Unknown"
out <- data.frame(group=character(),total=double(),n=integer())
for (g in sort(unique(d$group))) {
  values <- d$amount[d$group == g]
  out <- rbind(out,data.frame(group=g,total=sum(values),n=length(values)))
}
knitr::kable(out)
```
